entities.summary: Leader of Vanuatu (1980–1991). Vanua'aku Pati (Anglophone); first PM at independence; Anglican priest; socialist/Melanesian nationalist; suppressed Espiritu Santo secession (Coconut War, PNG troops, Jimmy Stevens imprisoned); Non-A
